description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating PyTorch neural network modules, extracting and loading weights, and handling timing results. It also includes type helpers and a function to check for the functorch library.

methods.name: _del_nested_attr
methods.description: Deletes a nested attribute from an nn.Module based on a list of attribute names.

methods.name: _set_nested_attr
methods.description: Sets a nested attribute of an nn.Module to a given value based on a list of attribute names.

methods.name: extract_weights
methods.description: Removes all parameters from a model, returning them as a tuple of tensors and their original attribute names.

methods.name: load_weights
methods.description: Loads a set of weights into a model, restoring its parameters from stored tensors.

methods.name: to_markdown_table
methods.description: Converts timing results into a markdown-formatted table string.

methods.name: from_markdown_table
methods.description: Parses a markdown-formatted table string into timing results data.

methods.name: check_for_functorch
methods.description: Checks if the functorch library is available for import.
